name: Bagan Marathon (Bagan Temple Marathon)
short_description: The Bagan Marathon is a full marathon, half marathon, and 10 km race held in Old Bagan, Myanmar on November 8, 2026.
ai_summary: The Bagan Marathon is a full marathon event scheduled for November 8, 2026, taking place in Old Bagan, Myanmar, near Nyaung-U. Organized by RUNderful Myanmar, the race offers three distance options: a full marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), and a 10 km race. Registration is currently open and can be completed via Google Form or Facebook.
